items.name: ChatWizard
items.description:
ChatWizard is an innovative chatbot builder that harnesses the power of GPT, a state-of-the-art language model developed by OpenAI.

With ChatWizard, website owners can easily create intelligent and engaging chatbots that can communicate with users in a natural and intuitive way.

The system uses website data to train GPT, ensuring that the chatbot is highly relevant to the website's content and can provide accurate and personalized responses to users' queries.
